set.body:
Parent epic: bd-01KXZZZWCEEDVD963AZA40FHE7

Objective:
Represent canonical contrast analysis as one named multivar method that lowers to the existing typed operator core and Gale numerical primitives.

Scope:
- Add a smart-constructed CanonicalEffectProblem over effect and residual operators or their certified dense realizations.
- Add CanonicalEffectFit with a nonnegative canonical root, optional direction or invariant-subspace result, rank and conditioning facts, Gale residual diagnostics, and provenance.
- Express the objective as the leading generalized Rayleigh functional through OperatorProgram, secondOrder, compress, and FunctionalFrame where those abstractions apply.
- Use gale.spectral.Eigen.eigSymmetricGeneralized with largest-algebraic selection for the dense reference path.
- Keep residual regularization explicit and typed; do not expose raw mode strings or a universal CCA options record.
- Map Gale numerical failures into the existing multivar error algebra.

Non-scope:
No fMRI design, folds, feature sets, temporal preparation, nonnegative constraints, spatial channels, or private eigen implementation.

Acceptance:
Analytic one-dimensional, direct generalized-eigen, scale, orthogonal-change-of-basis, repeated-root, non-SPD, rank-deficient, and diagnostic-residual tests pass on JVM and JS. The ordinary paired CCA path has no duplicated numerical engine.
set.title: CCA 1: add the Gale-backed canonical effect method to multivar
